# Library/member_report

Show a member's loans, and the notes on their record when asked. One member per call.

Source: `_commands/Library/member_report.py`.

Calls: `Library/find_member`, `Library/open_member`, `Member/list_member_loans`, `Record/show_notes`.
Depth: 1 (lower bound; open steps name no command)

## Inputs

| input | type | default | sample | classifier_confirms / classifier_decides | copied_from_command_text / record_named_in_command_text | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `member` | str | required | `<member>` |  | yes | the member's name |
| `loans` | bool | false | false |  |  | whether to name the books the member has on loan |
| `notes` | bool | false | false |  |  | whether to show the notes on the member's record |

- `member` must be written in the command text (`copied_from_command_text`).

## Example requests

- tell me about Raj Patel
- what has Ann Lee borrowed
- any notes on Mia Chen's record
- give me the summary for Ann Lee, loans and notes included
- how many books does Raj Patel have out, and what does his record say
- report on Mia Chen's account
- what is on Ann Lee's record, including her loans
- full picture for Mia Chen please
